授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This class will be taught in English.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本コースでは、英米法における様々なテーマについて考察する。英語技能の３要素（読解、会話、リスニング）の向上に焦点を当て、各クラス所定の教材に基づき、英語のみでネイティブにより授業が行われる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
In this class, we will read and discuss some interesting recent court decisions from English law. The cases that we read are all human rights law cases. The aim of the course is to improve students’ confidence and ability to speak and communicate in English.
By the end of the class, students will have:
- Improved their legal vocabulary in English.
- Improved their general English communication skills, particularly reading and speaking.
- Improved their knowledge of English law and human rights law.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: English communication, Anglo-American law, Human rights law
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
There are no pre-requisites for taking this class. This class is open to all students interested in improving An ability to communicate in English.
A willingness to read and talk in English.
